CaptureSettings.description: Defaults for explicit live capture commands.

crds.description: Capture schemas for all served CRD versions.

KubeconformSettings.description: Kubeconform's schema inputs and bounded execution policy.

builtin_schema_revision.description: Immutable commit of yannh/kubernetes-json-schema. Omitted uses Nyl's pinned revision.

schema_locations.description: Ordered local schema lookup templates, relative to nyl.toml.

skip.description: Explicit apiVersion/kind exclusions. Skipped resources appear in the summary.

strict.description: Reject unknown properties and duplicate YAML keys.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum duration in seconds for one validator invocation.

vendor_builtin_schemas.description: Require built-in schemas materialized by nyl vendor; never download during validation.

aliases.description:
Aliases for component-like resources keyed as `<apiVersion>/<kind>`.
Values are component kind targets (local component path or remote shortcut URL).

components_search_paths.description: Search paths for local component charts.

gitops_scaffold_path.description: Directory where GitOps configuration resources are scaffolded.

helm_chart_search_paths.description: Search paths for Helm chart names.

strip_empty_metadata_labels.description: Control when empty `metadata.labels` maps are stripped from emitted manifests.

StripEmptyMetadataLabelsMode.description: Controls when empty `metadata.labels` maps are stripped from emitted manifests.

oneOf.description: Always strip empty `metadata.labels` maps from emitted manifests.
Never strip empty `metadata.labels` maps from emitted manifests.
Strip empty `metadata.labels` maps only when running in an ArgoCD environment.

ValidationSettings.description: Project-wide validation policy. Named validator sections select implementations.

enabled.description: Run configured validators automatically on rendering commands.

VendorMode.description: Controls whether remote renderer inputs may use an in-tree vendor snapshot.

lfs_threshold_bytes.description: Text blobs at least this large are tracked through Git LFS.

mode.description: Resolution policy for vendored remote inputs.

path.description: In-tree directory containing the generated lock and artifact blobs.
